meta.about: Shared symbol-normalisation vectors. The terminal (src/core/instrument: tests/tst_symbol_input.cpp, tst_venue_symbols.cpp, tst_instrument_rank.cpp) and the backend's Python port of the normaliser run this same file. Every field present in a vector is compared exactly (lists in order); 'notes_include' entries must all appear in the parser's notes. Slugs: kind = empty | invalid | isin | contract | yahoo_symbol | fx_pair | crypto_pair | alias | ticker | name; asset_class = '' | equity | etf | fund | index | fx | crypto | future | option | bond | commodity; match = exact_symbol | exact_listing_code | exact_alias | exact_isin | prefix | name_contains | fuzzy.

sections.parse: parse_symbol_input(input, venue_hint, home): kind, asset_class, venue, candidates (ordered), canonical; plus canonical_symbol(input, venue_hint). source D = audit table D, plan = WP1 test plan.
sections.canonical_symbol: canonical_symbol(input, venue_hint) == expected, and canonical_symbol is idempotent.
sections.to_yahoo: to_yahoo(code, venue, class, country) == expected ('' = no Yahoo symbol).
sections.to_yahoo_tv: to_yahoo_tv(symbol, exchange, country) == expected (TradingView code space).
sections.from_yahoo: from_yahoo(symbol): valid, canonical, code, market, venue, class; instrument_id_for; display_symbol.
sections.round_trip: for each Yahoo symbol s: p = from_yahoo(s) is valid and to_yahoo(p.code, p.market, p.class) == s.
sections.currency: instrument_skeleton(symbol).currency == expected (minor units kept: GBp, ZAc, ILA, KWF, USX).
sections.rank: rank_instruments(instruments, query, {home, class_priority, allowed_classes, include_inactive}) returns exactly 'expected' (symbols, in order); 'match' gives the tier of named rows; 'former' the rows matched through a former symbol.
